title: Run the game once, unchanged
body:
Before changing anything, make sure the game builds and its quick tests pass on your copy.

Run this in the repo folder:

```sh
npm ci && node tools/kit.mjs check
```

It worked if the last lines say `pass` and `fail 0`.

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: Start the SNOW FORT minigame
check: npm run build && node --test test/mg-fort.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
body:
A minigame is one short round of Party. This tool writes a new one that already works (a sumo ring) and adds it to the game:

```sh
node tools/new-mg.mjs fort ft "SNOW FORT"
```

Then check it:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-fort.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: The build phase: 20 seconds to push up walls
body:
For the first 20 seconds of a round, rolling into the ground near your spot pushes up a snow wall. Nobody can throw yet.

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-fort.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: The snowball phase
body:
After the build phase, everyone can throw. A snowball that hits a wall breaks it. A fort with no walls left is out, and the last one standing wins.

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-fort.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: Teach the bots to build, then throw
body:
The AI players need to know the new rules, or every test round looks the same. Their brain is in `client/mg/fort.mjs`.

Check:

```sh
node --test test/mg-fort.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: See it on your page
body:
Your game has its own web page on GitHub Pages. Turn it on once: Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions. Every push then updates it. Open `client/party.html?mg=30` on your page to play SNOW FORT straight away.

Check that the site builds:

```sh
npm run build && node tools/site.mjs
```
